description: Get the most out of your Logitech webcam in Windows 8 with the Logitech Camera Controller app. Once installed, your webcam's full range of features and settings are seamlessly integrated and accessible from any Windows 8-style app that utilizes your webcam, including Microsoft's Camera App. Frame the perfect shot with digital zoom, pan and tilt. Enjoy richer video calling with helpful features such as face tracking and auto noise-cancellation. Or optimize picture quality with advanced settings like autofocus, exposure and more.
